head: /fold-bloom/ecology/

ecology.persistence: No authored fold relation is written by play. FOLD checks (start + N/2) % N on each resolution.
ecology.traversal: When FOLD is live, a same-type opposite cell may join. CASCADE then breadth-first traverses current gene neighborSet over same-type cells.
ecology.strength: Very legible and predictable; integrates cleanly with Ecology's richer breeding, memory, Garden and gene-topology systems.

fold_weave.persistence: foldAnchors[type] stores the last valid authored crease endpoint for each symbol family; CREASE_SET and CREASE_BREAK make changes explicit and RETURN preserves anchors.
fold_weave.traversal: predictWeave starts at the current bloom, adds the valid authored anchor as an explicit fold edge, then CASCADE begins from all reached nodes. Past play therefore changes future reachable topology.
fold_weave.failure_behavior: Anchors break when their cell changes type by DRIFT or RETURN mutation rather than silently pointing at invalid state.
fold_weave.strength: Turns FOLD from a static symmetry rule into player-authored graph memory; predictive graph and crease echoes make the causal path inspectable.

decision.do_not_promote: Fold Weave donor wholesale; do not replace Ecology's stable MIRROR default yet.
minimal_transfer: crease forecast/echo sufficient to make causality legible
decision.rationale: This mechanism adds a missing capability—player-authored persistent topology—without requiring the donor's whole app. It changes causal law, so default promotion still requires direct comparative play evidence.

promotion_gate: Add MIRROR / CREASE as explicit testable alternatives in a lab/experimental mode. Make CREASE default only after a direct playtest shows better agency/replay without materially degrading flow, legibility or ecology.
